name: 模板库
description: 把你笔记库里 Templates/ 文件夹的每一篇普通笔记当模板用:笔记里敲 /模板 插一段结构、命令面板或文件树右键「从模板新建」起一篇新笔记、「模板库」视图里逐个预览(变量已代入)。变量支持 {{date}} {{time}} {{title}} 以及 {{date:+1d:YYYY-MM-DD}} 这类偏移与格式。数据流向:模板和产物全都是你库里的普通 Markdown 文件,插件只读写你的本地笔记库,不联网、不调用任何模型、不执行模板里的任何代码。
descriptionEn: Every ordinary note in your vault's Templates/ folder is a template: type /Template in a note to insert a structure, use the command palette or the file-tree right-click "New from Template" to start a new note, and browse them all with live previews (variables already filled in) in the Template Library view. Variables cover {{date}} {{time}} {{title}} plus offsets and formats like {{date:+1d:YYYY-MM-DD}}. Where the data goes: templates and everything it creates are plain Markdown files in your own vault. The plugin only reads and writes your local vault — no network, no model calls, and it never executes code from a template.

onboarding.intro: 模板库 = 你自己的 Templates/ 文件夹。放一篇普通笔记进去,它就是一个模板。

steps.title: 先放一篇模板
steps.description: 在库里建 Templates/ 文件夹,把一篇写好骨架的普通笔记放进去(比如「周会.md」)。也可以在「模板库」视图里点「新建一个模板」,它会建一篇带示例的空模板并打开。

steps.title: 插进正在写的笔记
steps.description: 笔记里敲 / 选「模板」,浮层里挑一个,那一段结构就插在光标处。模板开头的 frontmatter 不会被插进正文中段。

steps.title: 从模板起一篇新笔记
steps.description: 命令面板「模板库:从模板新建笔记」,或在文件树右键你想放的文件夹选「从模板新建」——右键那条会把新笔记放进你点的那个文件夹。

steps.title: 变量
steps.description: {{date}} {{time}} {{title}} 直接用;要格式写 {{date:YYYY年MM月DD日}};要偏移写 {{date:+1d:YYYY-MM-DD}}(d/w/m/y,正负都行)。不认识的 {{xxx}} 原样留着,不会吃掉你的文字。

steps.title: 同名怎么办
steps.description: 目标名字已经被占用时,默认另存为「名字 2」并告诉你;想每次自己改名就在设置里打开「同名时先问我」。任何情况下都不会覆盖你已有的文件。

steps.title: 数据在哪
steps.description: 模板 = Templates/ 里的普通 .md;新建的笔记 = 你指定位置的普通 .md;插件只额外存一份「最近用过哪几个模板」,删了也不影响使用。

en.intro: The Template Library is just your own Templates/ folder. Drop an ordinary note in there and it becomes a template.

steps.title: Add a template
steps.description: Create a Templates/ folder in your vault and put an ordinary note with your skeleton in it (say "Weekly.md"). Or click "New template" in the Template Library view — it creates a starter template and opens it.

steps.title: Insert into the note you're writing
steps.description: Type / in a note and pick "Template". Choose one from the popover and that structure lands at your caret. A template's own frontmatter is never inserted into the middle of a note.

steps.title: Start a new note from a template
steps.description: Run "Note Templates: New from Template" from the command palette, or right-click the folder you want in the file tree and pick "New from Template" — that route puts the new note in the folder you clicked.

steps.title: Variables
steps.description: Use {{date}} {{time}} {{title}} directly; add a format like {{date:YYYY/MM/DD}}; add an offset like {{date:+1d:YYYY-MM-DD}} (d/w/m/y, positive or negative). Anything unrecognised is left exactly as you wrote it.

steps.title: When the name is taken
steps.description: By default it saves as "Name 2" and tells you. Turn on "Ask me when the name is taken" to rename it yourself each time. It never overwrites a file you already have.

steps.title: Where the data lives
steps.description: Templates are plain .md files in Templates/; new notes are plain .md files wherever you put them. The only extra thing stored is which templates you used recently — deleting that changes nothing.
